mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Mentor of the Meek: "Whenever another creature you control with power 2 or less enters, you may
# pay {1}. If you do, draw a card."
# Event: M21 Garruk's Uprising's "creature you control with power 4 or greater enters" read as
# POWER_LE 2 (Vanquish the Weak), "another" FNot(IS_SOURCE); effect: M21 Ghostly Pilferer's verified
# "you may pay {2}. If you do, draw a card." at {1}.
trigger = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAnd(
            children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.POWER_LE, count=QConst(value=2)),
                FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=Seq(
        steps=(
            OptionalEffect(
                inner=A(Verb.PAY, {
                    'cost': Cost(parts=(CostManaGeneric(amount=QConst(value=1)),)),
                }),
            ),
            Conditional(
                pred=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.MAY_DONE),
                then_effect=A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
            ),
        ),
    ),
)
abilities = [trigger, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Whenever another creature you control with power 2 or less enters, you may pay {1}.
If you do, draw a card.

mapping.notes: Garruk's Uprising's 'creature you control with power N ... enters' as another one with POWER_LE 2; Ghostly Pilferer's verified may-pay at {1}, then draw. packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/: mentor_of_the_meek_pays_for_each_small_creature, mentor_of_the_meek_may_decline.
